description: Balanced parameter templates for the B1/RVAE/diffusion semantic-retention experiment. The natural-language prompt is a canonical occluded-pedestrian carrier; executable occluder type, side, speed and risk are supplied by matrix controls. Pedestrian speeds are expressed as fractions of the actual SLEDGE/RVAE pedestrian_max_velocity and are materialized by the single three-stage runner before B1 construction, so feature-preprocessing clipping is never misclassified as RVAE/diffusion semantic loss.
prompt_templates: A pedestrian is hidden behind a parked vehicle on the {side} roadside and crosses the ego path from behind the parked vehicle at {speed} m/s.
A pedestrian is occluded by a parked vehicle on the {side} roadside and crosses the ego path from behind it at {speed} m/s.
A pedestrian behind a parked vehicle on the {side} roadside is hidden from ego and crosses the ego path at {speed} m/s.
A pedestrian is concealed behind a parked vehicle on the {side} roadside and crosses the ego path at {speed} m/s.
